name: Tonoris, Genesis Aegis's recollection-phase Obelisk summon
notes: Genesis Aegis's recollection trigger is a plain CardID switch-case inside ResolveBeforeRecollectionPhaseStart (GameLogic.php ~9089, the same dispatcher used for Foster processing) rather than a materialized-Enter/activateAbility macro, so the starting champion is patched directly to ta6qsesw2u -- no real level-up/lineage/element unlock needed, since the switch only reads the already-on-field object's CardID. Reaching player 1's own recollection phase uses the established 3-action shortcut: player 1 ends turn 1, player 2 ends their turn (still global turn 1), then player 1 declines their own MAT-phase materialize offer, auto-advancing into player 1's own BREC. TonorisRecollection() (CardDQHandlers.php ~2350) finds no obelisks chosen yet and queues an MZCHOOSE over all three myTempZone Obelisk options; choosing myTempZone-0 summons Obelisk of Armaments (wk0pw0y6is) onto the field via TonorisChooseObelisk and records the choice in Counters['tonoris_chosen'] (repeat choices across future recollection phases, and the other two Obelisk types, are out of scope for this fixture).

rulesClauses: At the beginning of your recollection phase, choose one that hasn't been chosen— Summon an Obelisk of Armaments token. • Summon an Obelisk of Fabrication token. • Summon an Obelisk of Protection token.
